techniques 1
technique "DebugController" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=1
  script "RenderColorTarget=ScnMap;RenderDepthStencilTarget=;ScriptExternal=Color;RenderColorTarget=;RenderDepthStencilTarget=;Pass=DebugController;"
  cmd 0 RenderColorTarget0 param="ScnMap" value=-1 text="ScnMap"
  cmd 1 RenderDepthStencilTarget param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 2 ScriptExternal param="-" value=0 text="Color"
  cmd 3 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 4 RenderDepthStencilTarget param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 5 Pass pass="DebugController" index=0 text="DebugController"
  pass 0 "DebugController" script=1 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
    script "Draw=Buffer;"
    cmd 0 DrawBuffer param="-" value=0 text="Buffer"
selection subsets=1 clamped=1
  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-0 "DebugController" "DebugController" "DebugController" "DebugController" "DebugController" "DebugController" "DebugController" "DebugController"
runs
  run "DebugController"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    suspend rt0=ScnMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw buffer pass=0 "DebugController" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=1 draws=1 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
